note: A structural role taxonomy (Source/Teacher, Questioner/Learner, Recipient, Transmitter, Custodian, Practitioner/Actor, Authority/Governor) abstracted from Bhagavad Gita Chapter 4 characters (Krishna, Arjuna, Vivasvan, Manu, Ikshvaku, Rajarsis), used as a pre-analogy structural analysis before mapping onto KnowledgeOS architecture; continues the same Gita-as-validation-lens thread as gita-chapter3-validation-exercise but is chapter-4-specific.

Gita-Chapter-4-derived proposal that Wisdom is a cross-cutting domain function mapping Knowledge/Context/Evidence/Rules/Authority to an ActionGuidance value drawn from a deontic vocabulary (Required/Permitted/Forbidden/Unknown, Do/Refrain/Defer/Escalate/Investigate), explicitly not to be reified as a literal Wisdom class; parallels but is not identical to the prior epistemic-vs-practical-decision-separation object.

Gita-Chapter-4-derived (Krishna remembers past births, Arjuna does not) three-layer memory formalization distinguishing current state S_t, historical lineage H, and accessible/authorized memory K(H); yields Provenance-vs-Lineage distinction and the claim that Ephemeral Agent Memory != Authoritative Knowledge Memory, used to validate the prior decision that .claude/ and .codex/ are not authoritative KnowledgeOS memory.

A dedicated, self-declared SECONDARY-SYNTHESIS analysis programme (distinct from the primary brainstorming corpus it analyzes) that inventories, timelines, and periodizes the 408-file phase_measure_theory brainstorming corpus into five successive regimes (R1 measure-theory/definition-crisis, R2 Question-series+lens, R3 Gita/Atma, R4 Computational Closures, R5 Step series 001-158), builds claim/decision/contradiction registries, and produces canonical-architecture v0.1/v0.2 documents plus a phase-archaeology cross-reference; explicitly analysis-only (no architecture decided by the analysis itself) and read-only against the source corpus.
